intro.text: A river that runs beneath Elantris and can be reached from a well inside the city.
A river of Arelon. It flows out of Lake Alonoe, passes beneath Elantris and meets the Sea of Fjorden in a bay near Kae.

description.text: Since Kae's plumbing failed with the Reod, the river has sometimes been turned aside to flush out the city's sewers.
Aon Eno, the Aon for water, includes the river.

items.text: Raoden and Karata climbed down into the river through a well in Elantris and let the current sweep them out of the city.
